en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European town. In the foreground are gardens, trees, wooden fences and half‑timbered farm buildings with steep tiled roofs. Behind them stands a compact cluster of houses. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall, slender spire and Baroque-style tower rising from a broad nave roof. The image has a wide white sky area and looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard of a rural townscape.
